definitions.explanation: The part of the body above the waist, including the chest, back, and arms. Commonly used in exercise, sports, and physical descriptions.

examples.japanese: {上体|じょうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。

examples.english: To bend the upper body forward.

examples.japanese: {上体|じょうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひねる⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I did a stretch where I twisted my upper body.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボクシング→ボクシング：05235_bokushingu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上体|じょうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: In boxing, upper body movement is very important.

notes:
{上体|じょうたい} refers to the upper part of the body from the waist up, including the chest, back, shoulders, and arms. It appears most often in fitness, sports, and physical therapy contexts where specific movements of the torso are described, and is more technical than the near-synonym ⟦{上半身|じょうはんしん}→上半身：11509_jouhanshin⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上体|じょうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to raise one's upper body)
- {上体|じょうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倒|たお}す→倒す：01954_taosu⟧ (to bend the upper body forward)
- {上体|じょうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひねる (to twist the upper body)
- {上体|じょうたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反|そ}らす→反らす：20852_sorasu⟧ (to arch the upper body backward)
- {上体|じょうたい}{起|お}こし (sit-ups)

USAGE:
- Commonly used in exercise instructions and sports commentary
- Focuses on the torso as a unit that moves, bends, or rotates
- ⟦{上半身|じょうはんしん}→上半身：11509_jouhanshin⟧ is a broader anatomical term; {上体|じょうたい} emphasizes the torso in motion

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{上半身|じょうはんしん}→上半身：11509_jouhanshin⟧ (upper half of the body — broader synonym)
- ⟦{下半身|かはんしん}→下半身：19453_kahanshin⟧ (lower body)
- ⟦{全身|ぜんしん}→全身：03313_zenshin⟧ (whole body)
